finding: Pollinations.ai: unlimited, no key, URL-based. Stability AI free tier: 25 credits/day. Hugging Face Inference: rate-limited but free.
Ollama + Llama 3.1 8B runs on Mac Mini M-series. 4-bit quantized fits in 4GB RAM. Good enough for agent routing and research summarization.
Piper TTS: offline, 100+ voices, <200ms latency. Coqui TTS: higher quality but heavier. Edge TTS (Microsoft): free, cloud-based, very natural.
Web Speech API: free in Chrome/Edge, supports continuous recognition. No install, no API key. Works over Tailscale to Mac Mini.
d-id.com free tier: 5 minutes of video per day. Upload photo, type text, get MP4 of face speaking. No install. Browser only. Fastest avatar path.
ntfy.sh: free, open-source push notifications. curl -d 'message' ntfy.sh/your-topic sends to phone app. No account needed. Self-hostable.
ffmpeg -f concat -i input.txt -vf scale=1024:1024 -c:v libx264 output.mp4 stitches images into video. 2 seconds per frame = 10 second clip from 5 images.
pip install edge-tts. Microsoft's neural TTS, free, no API key. edge-tts --text 'hello' --write-media out.mp3. Hundreds of voices. Best free TTS quality.
